item: Pancreatic polypeptide mixed-meal test to distinguish pancreatogenic (type 3c) from type 2 diabetes
status: Investigational; no FDA-cleared assay/indication for this use (research use within NCT03460769)
note: Claimed only as an investigational discriminator (C-ANAT-06)

item: New-onset-diabetes-based early detection of pancreatic cancer (e.g., ENDPAC-type enrichment)
status: Not a recommended screening practice; USPSTF recommends against screening average-risk asymptomatic adults for pancreatic cancer (2019, in force 2026-10-08)
note: Context for C-ANAT-08/C-ANAT-09; the atlas presents new-onset diabetes as a risk marker, not an endorsed screening test

item: Pancreatic cancer screening in average-risk asymptomatic adults
status: USPSTF Grade D — recommends AGAINST screening. Statement dated August 6, 2019, reaffirming the 2004 D recommendation. Applies to asymptomatic adults not known to be at high risk; explicitly EXCLUDES people with inherited genetic syndromes or a history of familial pancreatic cancer. Rationale: no evidence that screening or treating screen-detected cancer improves disease-specific or overall…
note: Verified by direct retrieval on 2026-10-08. The statement specifically names new-onset or preexisting diabetes, older age, smoking, obesity and chronic pancreatitis as raising risk only modestly, so adults with those factors remain within the recommendation against screening — a boundary the atlas…

item: Imaging surveillance in genetically high-risk individuals (EUS and MRI/MRCP)
status: Guideline-recommended practice for individuals meeting high-risk criteria (generally an estimated lifetime risk of about 5% or higher), as described and practised in the CAPS programme; not an FDA-regulated product and not supported by any randomised trial.
note: Status as described in the accessed text of ORIG-015, which states surveillance has been recommended for individuals estimated to be at 5% or higher lifetime risk and cites consensus guidance. I did not retrieve the primary NCCN or international consensus documents in this run; the specific…

item: Germline genetic testing for patients diagnosed with pancreatic cancer
status: Recommended — per the accessed text of ORIG-015, NCCN guidelines have since 2018 recommended that individuals with PDAC and their first-degree relatives be offered susceptibility gene testing.
note: Recorded as reported within a primary study rather than from the guideline itself; the NCCN document was not retrieved in this run. GENE owns the therapeutic consequences of a positive result.

item: Anti-inflammatory drugs for pancreatic cancer chemoprevention
status: Not approved and not guideline-recommended for this indication. Preclinical only: a COX-1/2 inhibitor reduced mPanIN/mPDAC development in mice and senescent PanINs were observed in nine chronic pancreatitis patients who had received anti-inflammatory drugs.
note: The authors of ORIG-014 explicitly frame anti-inflammatory chemoprevention as a concept put forward by their results, not as a tested clinical claim. The atlas must not present it as an option.

item: Irinotecan (CAMPTOSAR) - UGT1A1 genotype and severe neutropenia risk
status: In the current US prescribing information, Warnings and Precautions 5.3 states that individuals homozygous for UGT1A1*28 or *6 (*28/*28, *6/*6) or compound/double heterozygous (*6/*28) are at increased risk for severe or life-threatening neutropenia, are UGT1A1 poor metabolizers, and have increased SN-38 exposure; heterozygotes (*1/*28, *1/*6) are intermediate metabolizers who may also be at…
note: Read the full SPL XML on 2026-10-08 (setid e518dfc6-7e93-4fee-a66c-51e1ab71c056; SPL version 37, published 13 May 2026). The label now covers the *6 allele as well as *28, which matters for patients of East Asian ancestry in whom *6 predominates. The label recommends considering testing rather…

item: Capecitabine - DPYD variants, DPD deficiency, and pre-treatment testing
status: The current US prescribing information now instructs, in Dosage and Administration, to test patients for genetic variants of the DPYD gene prior to initiating capecitabine unless immediate treatment is necessary - and states in the same passage that an FDA-authorized test for detection of the DPYD gene to identify patients at risk of serious adverse reactions is NOT currently available, and that…
note: Read the full SPL XML on 2026-10-08 (setid 0b59e98c-5b34-4b93-90f6-20526f4d4f88, capecitabine tablets, NorthStar RxLLC; SPL version 2, published 23 July 2026). This is a generic manufacturer's label; brand and other generic labels should be expected to carry equivalent class language but were not…

item: Pembrolizumab for MSI-high/dMMR solid tumours (relevance: 0.8-2% of PDAC)
status: Described in the accessed text of GENE-006 as an FDA approval for unresectable or metastatic MSI-high or MMR-deficient solid tumours that have progressed following prior treatment and with no satisfactory alternative options, and for MSI-high/dMMR colorectal cancer after progression. NOT independently verified against the current label in this run.
note: Recorded as reported-in-source rather than verified, because the pembrolizumab label was not retrieved. Immune checkpoint indications belong substantively to the TX domain; this entry exists only to flag that the GENE-side prevalence figures (0.8% in GENE-006, 1-2% in SEC-GENE-03, 4.7% among…

item: Olaparib maintenance for germline BRCA-mutated metastatic PDAC after platinum
status: An approved US indication; the POLO randomised trial evidence underlying it is explicitly assigned to the TX domain by the atlas brief and was not ingested or verified here.
note: Cited only to mark the boundary. The GENE-side contribution is which genetic findings identify candidates - and specifically the evidence in GENE-016 and GENE-025 that biallelic and core-gene status, not gene-level annotation, tracks benefit. Approval wording not verified in this run.

item: Pembrolizumab for unresectable or metastatic MSI-high or mismatch-repair-deficient solid tumours (the tissue-agnostic…
status: FDA-approved (tissue-agnostic), label section 1.8; requires an FDA-authorised test and prior treatment with no satisfactory alternative. Label version dated 24 July 2026.
note: Verified directly from the current DailyMed label text. This is the one approved checkpoint-blockade route relevant to PDAC and is the stated exception to the failures recorded in TME-007 and TME-035. Approval evidence, eligibility and clinical use belong to the TX and IMMUNE domains; recorded…

item: Pegvorhyaluronidase alfa (PEGPH20) for metastatic hyaluronan-high PDAC
status: Not approved; confirmatory phase 3 (HALO 109-301, NCT02715804) failed its primary overall-survival endpoint (HR 1.00, 95% CI 0.80-1.27)
note: Status inferred from the published negative phase 3 (TME-004) and the absence of any approved indication; no FDA action document was retrieved in this run.

item: Hedgehog/Smoothened inhibitors (vismodegib, sonidegib, saridegib/IPI-926) for PDAC
status: Not approved for PDAC. Sonidegib and vismodegib are approved for basal cell carcinoma only.
note: No PDAC indication exists; the preclinical reversal in TME-002 and the CAF-composition shift in TME-013 are the mechanistic account of why the clinical programme was abandoned. Basal cell carcinoma approvals were not independently verified from labels in this run.

item: Sotigalimab (APX005M, CD40 agonist) for metastatic PDAC
status: Not approved; randomised phase 2 (PRINCE, NCT03214250) did not meet its 1-year overall-survival endpoint for either sotigalimab-containing arm (48.1%, P=0.062; 41.3%, P=0.223)
note: Posted registry results independently confirm the published rates (0.481 and 0.413 with two-sided CIs). Only the chemotherapy-plus-nivolumab arm met the endpoint (0.577).

item: Hydroxychloroquine as an autophagy inhibitor in PDAC
status: Not approved for oncologic use in PDAC; randomised phase 2 (NCT01506973) did not improve 12-month overall survival (41% versus 49%)
note: Hydroxychloroquine is approved in the US for malaria and for rheumatologic indications; the PDAC use is investigational. The single-agent trial (TME-026) also documented inconsistent target engagement.

item: Losartan as a stroma/solid-stress-directed adjunct in PDAC
status: Approved for hypertension; not approved for any oncologic indication. Oncologic evidence is a single-arm phase 2 (NCT01821729).
note: No randomised evidence of oncologic benefit exists; the atlas should not present losartan as a PDAC treatment.

item: CXCR4 inhibitors (plerixafor/AMD3100), CSF1R inhibitors, CXCR2 inhibitors and FAK inhibitors for PDAC
status: None approved for PDAC; all investigational in this indication
note: Plerixafor is approved in the US for haematopoietic stem-cell mobilisation only. The preclinical results in TME-019 to TME-022 have not produced an approved PDAC therapy; label-level verification of the non-PDAC approvals was not performed in this run.

item: Pembrolizumab for MSI-H/dMMR unresectable or metastatic solid tumours (includes PDAC)
status: FDA-approved tissue-agnostic indication, as determined by an FDA-authorized test
note: Label indication 1.8; grounds MSI/MMR testing in PDAC. Checked via DailyMed label updated 2026-07-24.

item: Zenocutuzumab (Bizengri) for NRG1 fusion-positive advanced pancreatic adenocarcinoma
status: FDA accelerated approval (ORR/DOR)
note: Label section 1.2; patient selection by NRG1 fusion but 'An FDA-approved test for the detection of NRG1 gene fusions is not currently available,' so detection relies on laboratory NGS/RNA assays.

item: BRACAnalysis CDx (germline BRCA1/2, whole blood) companion diagnostic for olaparib in pancreatic cancer
status: FDA-approved companion diagnostic (P140020/S019, 12/27/2019)
note: Only pancreatic-cancer-specific CDx; germline test, not a tumour/imaging diagnostic (POLO trial owned by TX).

item: ctDNA / molecular residual disease assay as an FDA companion diagnostic in pancreatic cancer
status: None approved for PDAC
note: Signatera ctDNA MRD CDx is approved only for muscle-invasive bladder cancer (atezolizumab, P260004, 05/15/2026); pancreatic ctDNA use is laboratory-developed/off-label.

item: Somatic + germline molecular testing (MSI/MMR, BRCA, NTRK fusion) for treatment-eligible pancreatic cancer
status: Guideline-recommended (ASCO 2020)
note: ASCO metastatic PDAC guideline update recommends testing to select pembrolizumab, olaparib, larotrectinib or entrectinib; notes limited pancreatic-specific evidence.

item: Gemcitabine (single agent) - pancreatic cancer
status: Approved; NDA 020509 original approval 1996-05-15; generic label section 1.4 'as a single agent for the treatment of pancreatic cancer'
note: Date from Drugs@FDA via openFDA

item: FOLFIRINOX components (fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, irinotecan) - pancreatic cancer
status: Regimen not FDA-labeled. Fluorouracil label lists pancreatic adenocarcinoma (section 1.4) and the 400 mg/m2 bolus + 2400-3000 mg/m2/46 h infusional schedule with leucovorin; oxaliplatin label: colorectal indications only; irinotecan (Camptosar) label: colorectal only (GENE SEC-01); leucovorin: labeled with 5-FU for colorectal cancer (not examined in detail).
note: Use in PDAC is guideline-based, off-label for oxaliplatin/irinotecan

item: nab-paclitaxel (Abraxane) with gemcitabine - first-line metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma
status: Approved 2013-09-06 (NDA 021660 SUPPL-37 efficacy); label section 1.3 current (DailyMed Apr 06, 2026); no adjuvant or locally advanced indication

item: Liposomal irinotecan (Onivyde) + 5-FU/LV - after gemcitabine-based therapy
status: Approved 2015-10-22 (NDA 207793 original); label current (Mar 05, 2025); not indicated as single agent

item: Liposomal irinotecan (Onivyde) + oxaliplatin/5-FU/LV (NALIRIFOX) - first-line metastatic
status: Approved 2024-02-13 (NDA 207793 SUPPL-16 efficacy); label section 1 current
note: Onivyde dose 50 mg/m2 q2w in NALIRIFOX

item: Olaparib (Lynparza) maintenance - gBRCA metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma after >=16 weeks platinum
status: Approved 2019-12-27 (NDA 208558 SUPPL-10 efficacy); label current (Jul 25, 2025); companion diagnostic required
note: Germline only; somatic BRCA/PALB2 not labeled

item: Pembrolizumab (Keytruda) - MSI-H/dMMR solid tumors
status: Accelerated approval 2017-05-23 (BLA 125514 SUPPL-14); regular approval 2023-03-28 per Drugs@FDA SUPPL-132 (FDA notice date widely cited as 2023-03-29); label section 1.8 current (Jul 24, 2026)
note: Label Clinical Studies table: pancreatic cancer n=22, ORR 18%

item: Pembrolizumab (Keytruda) - TMB-H (>=10 mut/Mb) solid tumors
status: Accelerated approval 2020-06-16 (BLA 125514 SUPPL-71/90 per Drugs@FDA); label section 1.18 current
note: Supplement-to-indication mapping inferred from label effective date

item: Larotrectinib (Vitrakvi) - NTRK fusion solid tumors
status: Approved 2018-11-26 (NDA 210861 original, accelerated); label (May 25, 2026) indication text no longer carries accelerated-approval wording
note: Conversion to regular approval not independently verified

item: Entrectinib (Rozlytrek) - NTRK fusion solid tumors
status: Approved 2019-08-15 (NDA 212725 original, accelerated); label (Dec 10, 2025) still states accelerated approval

item: Selpercatinib (Retevmo) - RET fusion solid tumors (tumor-agnostic)
status: Accelerated approval 2022-09-21 (NDA 213246 SUPPL-7/8); label indication 1.4 revised 07/2026 (SUPPL-17 approved 2026-07-14) now covering adults and pediatric patients >=2 years without accelerated-approval wording
note: Conversion/expansion details not verified against FDA notice

item: Dabrafenib + trametinib (Tafinlar + Mekinist) - BRAF V600E solid tumors (tumor-agnostic)
status: Accelerated approval 2022-06-22 (NDA 202806 SUPPL-22); label (May 21, 2026) still states accelerated approval; patients >=1 year
note: No pancreatic cohort in ROAR

item: Zenocutuzumab-zbco (Bizengri) - NRG1 fusion pancreatic adenocarcinoma and NSCLC
status: Accelerated approval 2024-12-04 (BLA 761352 original); SUPPL-10 approved 2026-05-08 adding cholangiocarcinoma (label May 25, 2026, sections 1.1-1.3)
note: Pancreatic indication remains under accelerated approval per label asterisk

item: Tumor Treating Fields (Optune Pax) - locally advanced pancreatic cancer with gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel
status: FDA premarket approval announced 2026-02-12 (PMA; P250034 per accessdata listing, document not fetched)
note: Device, not a drug label

item: S-1 (tegafur/gimeracil/oteracil) - adjuvant pancreatic cancer
status: Not FDA-approved; standard in Japan (JASPAC 01)
note: No DailyMed entry expected

item: Rucaparib - pancreatic cancer maintenance
status: Not FDA-approved for pancreatic cancer (phase 2 only); registry NCT03140670 TERMINATED with results posted 2023-09-28

item: Alliance A021806 (NCT04340141) perioperative vs adjuvant mFOLFIRINOX, resectable PDAC
status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING; primary completion 2028-12-31; no results posted; no efficacy publication found
note: Trial without published results

item: PREOPANC-3 (NCT04927780) perioperative vs adjuvant mFOLFIRINOX, resectable PDAC
status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING; primary completion 2027-01; no results posted
note: Trial without published results

item: NorPACT-1 (NCT02919787), PANACHE01 (NCT02959879), CONKO-007 (NCT01827553), LAP07 (NCT00634725), PRODIGE 4…
status: Published (peer-reviewed) but no results posted on ClinicalTrials.gov
note: Registry route unavailable for counting

item: Neoadjuvant therapy for borderline resectable / selected resectable PDAC
status: guideline-recommended (NCCN category 1/2A depending on setting)
note: Clinical-practice guideline, not an FDA device/drug approval; surgical sequencing recommendation.

item: Minimally invasive (laparoscopic/robotic) distal pancreatectomy for cancer
status: accepted practice in experienced centres; supported by DIPLOMA RCT long-term data
note: Technique, not an approval item; laparoscopic Whipple remains cautioned after LEOPARD-2.

item: ISGPS definitions (POPF 2016, DGE 2007, PPH 2007)
status: consensus definitions in standard use (US practice adopts them)
note: Reporting standards for complications; used in SURG-016.

item: Pancrelipase (Creon and others) for exocrine pancreatic insufficiency incl. after pancreatectomy
status: FDA-approved; label effective 2024-02-28; dosing caps 2,500 units/kg/meal, 10,000 units/kg/day
note: Pancreatic cancer is not named in the indication text but exocrine insufficiency from any cause is covered.

item: Ponsegromab (anti-GDF-15) for cancer cachexia
status: Investigational; phase 2 complete (NCT05546476, results posted); phase 3 in pancreatic cancer recruiting (NCT06989437)
note: No FDA approval.

item: Anamorelin for cancer cachexia
status: Not FDA-approved (approved in Japan 2021); US pancreatic trial NCT04844970 terminated (n=4)
note: ASCO 2020/2023 cachexia guideline does not recommend it in the US.

item: Rivaroxaban / apixaban primary VTE prophylaxis in ambulatory cancer patients
status: Off-label (labels cover VTE treatment/secondary prevention); ASCO 2023 guideline permits offering to Khorana >=2 patients
note: Enoxaparin (Lovenox) label likewise lacks a cancer-outpatient prophylaxis indication.

item: Irinotecan liposome (Onivyde) diarrhea management (loperamide/atropine) and neutropenia warnings
status: FDA label effective 2025-03-03 with boxed warnings
note: Loperamide for late diarrhea of any severity; atropine for early diarrhea.

item: Olanzapine for chemotherapy-induced nausea
status: Off-label; ASCO 2020 antiemetic guideline option

item: Duloxetine for painful chemotherapy-induced neuropathy
status: Off-label for CIPN; ASCO 2020 guideline moderate recommendation

item: Calmangafodipir (PledOx) for oxaliplatin neuropathy prevention
status: Not approved; phase 3 negative with hypersensitivity signal

item: EUS-guided gastroenterostomy with lumen-apposing metal stent for malignant GOO
status: Device FDA-cleared for other indications; EUS-GE use off-label; two RCTs favor it over duodenal stents
note: DRA-GOO 2024 paper retracted and republished 2025 (cite the 2025 version).

item: Biliary self-expanding metal stents (covered/uncovered) for malignant biliary obstruction
status: FDA-cleared devices; RCT evidence supports SEMS for preoperative drainage when drainage is indicated

item: Pegfilgrastim/G-CSF primary prophylaxis with FOLFIRINOX
status: G-CSF products FDA-approved for FN risk reduction with myelosuppressive chemotherapy; FOLFIRINOX listed as high FN-risk regimen (NCCN); no pancreatic-specific RCT located
note: Neulasta SPL published 2026-08-17.

item: Daraxonrasib (RASONQUE) - metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma
status: FDA-approved 26 August 2026 for adults with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who have received at least one prior systemic therapy or who are not candidates for multiagent systemic therapy; 300 mg orally once daily. First RAS-targeted therapy approved for pancreatic cancer.
note: The indication as written contains no RAS mutation requirement and the FDA page does not mention a companion diagnostic, even though the pivotal trial's dual primary endpoints were defined in the RAS G12-mutant subpopulation. The page also does not state whether the approval was regular or…

item: Sotorasib (LUMAKRAS) - pancreatic cancer
status: NOT approved for pancreatic cancer. Approved indications are KRAS G12C-mutated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC after >=1 prior systemic therapy (accelerated approval) and, with panitumumab, KRAS G12C-mutated metastatic colorectal cancer after fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin and irinotecan therapy, each requiring an FDA-approved test.
note: Label version published 30 January 2025. The pancreatic data (RAS-001) were published in 2023 and did not lead to an indication.

item: Adagrasib (KRAZATI) - pancreatic cancer
status: NOT approved for pancreatic cancer. Approved indications are KRAS G12C-mutated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC after >=1 prior systemic therapy and, with cetuximab, KRAS G12C-mutated locally advanced or metastatic CRC after fluoropyrimidine, oxaliplatin and irinotecan therapy; both accelerated approvals based on ORR and DOR.
note: Label version published 2 April 2026. The 33% pancreatic response rate in KRYSTAL-1 (RAS-002) did not lead to a pancreatic indication.

item: Zoldonrasib (RMC-9805) - KRAS G12D
status: Investigational; no approval. Phase 1/1b NCT06040541 RECRUITING (estimated enrolment 604, estimated primary completion 31 December 2026, no posted results). Phase 3 pancreatic trials: RASolute 305 (NCT07621718, zoldonrasib + investigator-choice chemotherapy versus placebo + chemotherapy, double-blind, n=670 estimated, RECRUITING, requires documented KRAS G12D status) and RASolute 309…
note: No peer-reviewed first-in-human efficacy publication for zoldonrasib was retrievable; the discovery paper (RAS-034) is abstract-only. This is a recorded shortfall.

item: MRTX1133 - KRAS G12D
status: Investigational; phase 1 NCT05737706 TERMINATED with 63 patients enrolled. Registry reason for stopping: 'Formulation challenges'. Last update posted 6 April 2025.
note: Important for the atlas: the drug that generated the strongest preclinical pancreatic data for G12D inhibition (RAS-004, RAS-035) never completed a human efficacy evaluation, and the stated reason is pharmaceutical rather than lack of effect. MRTX1133 remains in wide use as a research tool.

item: Glecirasib (JAB-21822) - KRAS G12C
status: Not FDA-approved. Reported in the peer-reviewed literature as holding US orphan drug designation and a breakthrough therapy designation in China for KRAS G12C-mutated pancreatic cancer.
note: Designation statements were taken from the discussion of Janne et al. 2026 (RAS-018) and were not verified against an FDA or Chinese regulatory primary source.

item: Olomorasib (LY3537982) - KRAS G12C
status: Not approved. Reported in the primary publication as having received FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation in August 2025 for olomorasib in combination with pembrolizumab for first-line unresectable advanced or metastatic KRAS G12C-mutant NSCLC with PD-L1 >=50%.
note: Designation is for lung, not pancreatic, cancer; taken from the publication text rather than an FDA primary source.

item: Elironrasib (RMC-6291) - RAS(ON) G12C-selective
status: Investigational; no approval. NCT06128551 (elironrasib and daraxonrasib as monotherapies and in combination) RECRUITING, estimated enrolment 534, last update 22 September 2026, no posted results.
note: The discovery paper (RAS-042) states preliminary clinical activity in patients who progressed on first-generation inactive-state G12C inhibitors, but no efficacy publication with denominators was retrievable.

item: RASolute 302 (NCT06625320) - pivotal phase 3
status: Phase 3, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING; start 16 October 2024; actual enrolment 500; dual primary endpoints PFS and OS in the RAS G12-mutant population; estimated primary completion June 2026; last update posted 2 June 2026; no results posted on ClinicalTrials.gov.
note: Results exist only in the NEJM publication (RAS-033), whose full text was not retrievable, and on the FDA approval page. The registry's absence of posted results is why RAS-033 could not be counted as abstract_plus_registry_results.

item: RASolute 303 (NCT07491445) - first-line phase 3
status: Phase 3, RECRUITING; start 9 March 2026; estimated enrolment 900; three arms (daraxonrasib monotherapy; daraxonrasib + gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel; gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel); dual primary endpoints PFS and OS; estimated primary completion June 2028; last update posted 2 October 2026; no results.
note: Tests whether the second-line benefit extends to first line and whether adding chemotherapy to a RAS inhibitor adds value.

item: RASolute 304 (NCT07252232) - adjuvant phase 3 in resected PDAC
status: Phase 3, RECRUITING; start 15 December 2025; estimated enrolment 500; adjuvant daraxonrasib versus standard-of-care observation; primary endpoint disease-free survival per investigator; requires R0/R1 resection, no evidence of recurrence or metastasis, and prior perioperative multi-agent chemotherapy; estimated primary completion 10 May 2029; last update posted 23 September 2026; no results.
note: This is the only randomised test of RAS-targeted therapy in the adjuvant/minimal-residual-disease setting. The control arm is observation, not active treatment, and the primary endpoint is investigator-assessed DFS with central review as a secondary endpoint.

item: ELI-002 (mutant KRAS amphiphile vaccine) - adjuvant/MRD setting
status: Investigational; no approval. AMPLIFY-201 (NCT04853017, phase 1, n=25) COMPLETED. AMPLIFY-7P (NCT05726864, phase 1/2, n=158) ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING with no posted results, last update 10 July 2026. An expanded access protocol (NCT07083479, AMPLIFY-EAP) is listed NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE.
note: The randomised efficacy question for a KRAS vaccine in minimal residual disease is therefore still unanswered as of 2026-10-08.

item: Erlotinib plus gemcitabine - pancreatic cancer
status: FDA-approved for pancreatic cancer on the basis of NCIC CTG PA.3 (RAS-037), but rarely used in practice given a median survival gain of about 10 days.
note: Status asserted from the trial publication and its role in the historical record; the current DailyMed erlotinib label was not separately retrieved in this run. Flagged as a partial verification.

item: Daraxonrasib FDA designations (orphan drug; breakthrough therapy in first-line mPDAC)
status: Reported in oncology trade press (orphan drug designation October 2025; breakthrough therapy designation in first-line metastatic PDAC September 2026). NOT VERIFIED against an FDA primary source.
note: The FDA approval page for daraxonrasib does not state these designations. Do not present as verified fact in the atlas without an FDA primary source.

item: KRAS wild-type targeted treatment in PDAC (NRG1/ALK/RET/BRAF fusions and mutations, mismatch-repair deficiency)
status: Owned by the GENE and TX domains; cited here only. This domain makes no regulatory claim about tissue-agnostic approvals.
note: Per the domain brief, KRAS wild-type targeted treatment is GENE/TX territory. See GENE-005 (Philip et al., molecular characterisation of KRAS wild-type PDAC) and the TX records for larotrectinib, selpercatinib, zenocutuzumab, dabrafenib/trametinib and pembrolizumab.

item: Autogene cevumeran (BNT122 / RO7198457), individualized mRNA neoantigen vaccine, for resected PDAC
status: Investigational; NOT FDA-approved for any indication. The randomized phase 2 IMCODE003 (NCT05968326) is ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING with an estimated enrolment of 260, a primary endpoint of disease-free survival, a primary completion date of 2031-01-01 and NO results posted (hasResults false); registry status verified 2026-09, last update posted 2026-09-09.
note: Results or not: NOT. Nothing randomized has been reported for this agent in PDAC; all published clinical data come from the 19-patient phase 1 and its follow-up.

item: ELI-002 (Amph-Peptides + Amph-CpG-7909), off-the-shelf mutant-KRAS vaccine
status: Investigational; NOT FDA-approved. AMPLIFY-201 (NCT04853017) phase 1 complete, study visits concluded August 2024. AMPLIFY-7P (NCT05726864), phase 1/2, is ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING with ACTUAL enrolment 158, primary completion 2026-04-20, completion 2026-11, and NO results posted; registry status verified 2026-07, last update posted 2026-07-10.
note: Fully enrolled and past its primary completion date with no posted results as of the check date.

item: GVAX Pancreas (GM-CSF-secreting allogeneic tumour-cell vaccine) and CRS-207 (Listeria monocytogenes expressing…
status: NOT FDA-approved for any indication. The randomized phase 2b ECLIPSE (NCT02004262) missed its primary OS endpoint (3.7 vs 4.6 months, HR 1.17, 95% CI 0.84-1.64); a randomized phase 2 adding nivolumab (NCT02243371) missed its primary OS endpoint (HR 0.86, 95% CI 0.55-1.34); a randomized phase 2 adding nivolumab plus ipilimumab (NCT03190265) missed its primary ORR endpoint (0% and 7%).
note: Three negative randomized readouts across three combination strategies on the same backbone.

item: Motixafortide (BL-8040), CXCR4 antagonist, for pancreatic cancer
status: NOT FDA-approved for pancreatic cancer. Motixafortide holds an FDA approval only for haematopoietic stem-cell mobilisation in multiple myeloma, a different indication. COMBAT (NCT02826486) is COMPLETED with posted results and was never followed by a randomized PDAC trial.
note: An approved drug with an unapproved and unconfirmed oncology use - a distinction worth keeping explicit for readers who find the drug name in a search.

item: Satricabtagene autoleucel (satri-cel, CT041), claudin18.2-directed autologous CAR-T
status: Approved by China's National Medical Products Administration in June 2026 for Claudin18.2-positive, HER2-negative advanced gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma after failure of at least two prior lines - the first CAR-T therapy approved for a solid tumour anywhere. PANCREATIC CANCER IS NOT IN THE INDICATION. There is NO FDA approval in the United States for any indication.
note: Real-world availability: a Chinese approval for gastric cancer. A reader with pancreatic cancer cannot obtain this product on label in any country.

item: Mesothelin-directed CAR-T (mRNA-electroporated CARTmeso; lentiviral mesothelin CAR-T)
status: Investigational; NO mesothelin CAR-T product is FDA-approved for any indication. Phase 1 experience in PDAC showed a best overall response of stable disease.
note: Not available outside trials.

item: KRAS G12D-directed TCR gene therapy (HLA-C*08:02-restricted)
status: Investigational; NOT FDA-approved. The published pancreatic experience was delivered under single-patient investigational new drug applications. Requires the patient to carry BOTH KRAS G12D and HLA-C*08:02.
note: Real-world availability: single-patient INDs and trials only; a subsequent phase 1/2 cohort report targeting KRAS G12V exists but its full text was not retrievable (SEC-IMMUNE-06).

item: Pembrolizumab for MSI-high / mismatch-repair-deficient and for TMB-high unresectable or metastatic solid tumours, as…
status: FDA-approved on a tissue-agnostic basis; pancreatic cancer falls within those indications. THE APPROVAL ITSELF AND ITS PIVOTAL TRIAL DATA ARE RECORDED BY THE TX DOMAIN and are cited, not re-recorded, here. note: This is the ONLY approved immunotherapy pathway that a person with pancreatic cancer can access in the US, and roughly 1 in 125 patients is eligible. Real-world availability therefore depends on whether MSI/MMR testing was performed and on which specimen.

item: PF-04136309 (CCR2 inhibitor), IMC-CS4 (anti-CSF1R antibody), pelareorep (oncolytic reovirus), Flt3L, TLR2-directed…
status: All investigational; NONE is FDA-approved for pancreatic cancer or, in the case of Flt3L mobilisation and TLR2-directed agents, for any cancer indication relevant here. The lymph-node-targeted vaccine plus TCR-T combination is preclinical.
note: Available only in clinical trials, where such trials exist; no registered PDAC trial of a TLR2-directed agent was identified in this review.

item: Summary position: immunotherapy approved specifically for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma
status: NONE. As of 2026-10-08 there is no immunotherapy - no vaccine, no engineered cell therapy, no checkpoint inhibitor and no immune combination - approved by the FDA for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma as a disease. The only route by which a person with PDAC can receive an approved immunotherapy is the tissue-agnostic MSI-high/dMMR or TMB-high indication, which fewer than 1 in 100 qualify for.
note: Everything else described in this domain is available only inside a clinical trial. Kept deliberately separate from the early-study, randomized-evidence and registry-recruitment records above.
